title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - MemorySize
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/MemorySize. The number of bytes that can be stored on a digital storage. Subclass of QuantityKind per the Gaia-X ontology; applicableUnit and quantityValue are QuantityKind's own properties, inlined here since MemorySize is the concrete, referenceable entity used by every other model's memory/storage-size Relationship.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MemorySize'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

applicableUnit.description: Property. Unit of the quantity value, from QUDT vocabulary. Fixed set per the source ontology's validation rule: BYTE, KiloBYTE, MegaBYTE, GigaBYTE, or TeraBYTE.

quantityValue.description: Property. Measurement of the memory/storage size, in the unit given by applicableUnit.
